title: Penpot Libraries & Templates | Lucide Icons (Penpot kit)
notes:
Lucide is an open-source SVG icon library offering over 1,000 customizable icons with consistent design, scalable for various platforms. The Penpot library integrates Lucide icons for seamless design

Free Penpot community file (CC BY 4.0: credit the author). Open it in Penpot (free, open source) or download the .penpot file from this page.
